documents.unit: AI at CWRU (AI Governance Committee, AI Task Force)
documents.title: Governance & Policies | AI at CWRU
documents.quality_note: University AI policy statement: AI use must follow the existing Academic Integrity, Acceptable Use and data policies; faculty retain discretion; approved tools only; no restricted data. Short but substantive.

documents.title: Guidance on integrating AI (artificial intelligence) into the CWRU classroom
documents.quality_note: Provost guidance: faculty have complete discretion (prohibit, ask permission, or allow with citation), must state expectations in every syllabus, and must enforce academic conduct standards; mentions AI-detection software.

documents.unit: Office of the Provost (AI Task Force)
documents.title: Example AI Policies, Suitable for Course Syllabi
documents.quality_note: Known URL from earlier pass. Sample syllabus statements across the permissive-to-restrictive range; advisory templates, not rules.

documents.unit: University Center for Innovation in Teaching and Education (UCITE)
documents.title: Teaching and Learning with Generative Artificial Intelligence Systems
documents.quality_note: Teaching-centre page that repeats the provost guidance (faculty discretion, syllabus statement) and links to a living survey of faculty syllabus statements; overlaps the provost page, so lower priority.
